integrity.claim_basis: Analytic Clifford-algebra proof using the primary paper's Hilbert-space, Majorana, commutation, and tracelessness statements; finite code checks are corroborative only.
integrity.source_version: Earliest public arXiv version independently used for the scientific premises and date.
integrity.unproved_limits: No claim of generic spectral simplicity, no classification of extra symmetries, and no change to operator-growth theorems.

scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the vertex-star symmetry sectors, not spectra inside the sectors or degeneracies caused by additional structure.
The scalar sign in the product of all corrected stars depends on the source's deliberately unspecified monomial-order convention.
An equivalent formulation may exist in weakly indexed Majorana or tensor-model literature under different terminology.
title: Exact symmetry sectors for the complete-graph Majorana cartoon matrix model
